review_source.located_in: local Codex session record (private, not published)

findings.original_text: PR保存paired費用の再現gateの説明：実装では、この検査はCOST_COMPARISON内だけで実行されます。shot-onlyでも実行するように読める報告文を、stage別に明確化してください。

target.function: costs (called only when COST_COMPARISON is authorized)

findings.problem: Report/plan listed the PR saved paired-metric reproduction (and the n32 pairing/seed gate) among general pre-execution gates; a shots-only result carried no record that they were not run.
findings.reproduction: shots-only evaluation on ARTIFICIAL data with a corrupted saved PR paired metric completes without any gate record; old code raises KeyError in the new regression test.
findings.impact: Description and output transparency only; no computed value depends on it. Shots-only runs never claimed a paired-cost check in data, but the prose and plan text implied it.
findings.fix: Result gates PR_saved_paired_metric_reproduction and PR_confirmation_n32_pairing are always present with stage=COST_COMPARISON; executed=false/NOT_EXECUTED_IN_NONCANCELLATION_SHOTS_STAGE in shots-only, REPRODUCED/PASS with counts in the cost stage. Plan v2 lists gates by stage; report text corrected.

findings.original_text: S4の検証済み表示：S4_model_validated_onがB2未PASSでも無条件に設定されます。「検証予定範囲」または「B2結合時のみ検証済み」という表現に修正すべきです。
findings.problem: lineage_limitations.S4_model_validated_on=FOUR_REGISTERED_B2_AXES_ONLY was set for every run, including shots-only runs without any B2 PASS.
findings.reproduction: shots-only evaluation output contains S4_model_validated_on; new regression test fails on old code.
findings.impact: Label only; S4 model costs were already used only after the B2 gate, which requires a complete four-axis PASS.
findings.fix: Lineage label replaced by S4_model_validation_scope=PLANNED_FOUR_REGISTERED_B2_AXES_VALIDATED_ONLY_WHEN_B2_FULL_PASS_BOUND; new runtime S4_model_status is UNVALIDATED_B2_FULL_PASS_NOT_BOUND_S4_MODEL_NOT_USED unless the B2 gate accepted a full PASS.

after_fix: both new regression tests PASS; see limited_validation_v2.json
